subject: Interim credits escrow offer while PO is under procurement review
messages:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@azurehealth.co>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: AzureHealth Finance <finance@azurehealth.co>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot access — procurement paused, asking about short term coverage

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team loved the latency numbers and the tracing hooks. We kicked this up to procurement this morning and I wanted to flag a likely multi-week pause: finance requires a signed PO and a review of your vendor questionnaire before final approval.

We have a narrow window to complete a set of integrations (data connector + few eval prompts) and would love to keep the sandbox live so the engineers don't lose momentum. Is there any way Redwood can provide a small interim credit or temporary voucher (7–10 days) while procurement finishes its review? We can share the scanned PO and the security checklist they requested.

Attachments: AzureHealth_PO_scanned.pdf; requested-security-checklist.xlsx

I appreciate any flexibility — if helpful I can loop in our procurement lead.

Best,
Aisha
Aisha Rahman
CTO, AzureHealth

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@azurehealth.co>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Pilot access — procurement paused, asking about short term coverage

Folks — forwarding Aisha's note. AzureHealth is in the middle of a procurement hold but they have a signed PO scanned and asked for a short 7–10 day credit to keep the pilot live. Their use case looks like a clear POC to production motion (embedding + chat routing tests).

Requesting quick guidance: can we approve an "interim escrow credit" (non-refundable, capped at $1,200) pending PO clearance? If so, I can draft the voucher terms (credit expires after 10 days, auto-applies to account, revocable if PO doesn't arrive). Legal usually wants an MSA signature but we can make this conditional.

Notes:
- Deal id: RDW-2026-0894
- Related account: AzureHealth (US)
- They've attached the PO scan and our requested security checklist

Ben — any objections on the credit cap? Dev/Laura — does this present any operational risk from a provisioning standpoint?

Thanks,
Marissa
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 13:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot access — procurement paused, asking about short term coverage

Quick answer: I'm comfortable with a time-bound interim credit as long as we put a $1,500 cap (round up from Marissa's suggestion) and require a signed acknowledgement that the PO is in process. Finance will record this as a contra-revenue hold and we'll clear it when the PO lands.

Conditions I want in the voucher language: 
- Credit valid for 10 days from issuance; any unused credit expires and is not refunded.
- Redemption limited to sandbox endpoints only (no production model pinning).
- Account must provide a projected PO date and contact.
- If we don't receive a signed PO within 30 days, credit converts to trial consumption (no refunds) and finance may request repayment.

Laura — can you confirm there's no security blocker in the checklist? Dev — any rate-limit or quota risk if we re-enable sandbox bursts for them?

Ben
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@azurehealth.co>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 15:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot access — procurement paused, asking about short term coverage

Hi Aisha — thanks for the quick turnaround and for sending the PO scan. We can offer a 10-day interim credit voucher capped at $1,500 while your procurement team completes the review. To keep things moving I outlined the conditions below and attached the voucher terms as a short stub. If that looks OK we can activate the credit today.

Summary of interim credit (activated on issuance):
- Amount: up to $1,500 sandbox credit
- Validity: 10 days from activation (no refunds for unused credit)
- Scope: sandbox endpoints only; no production model pinning or reserved capacity
- Requirements: you confirm PO is in progress and share the procurement contact; you sign the short acknowledgement (DocuSign link).
- Fallback: if we do not receive a signed PO within 30 days, finance will close the hold and any consumed credit remains non-refundable.

DocuSign link (acknowledgement): https://www.docusign.com/en/rdw-msasignup
Redwood deal record: https://app.redwood.ai/deals/RDW-2026-0894

Attachments: interim-voucher-terms.pdf (stub)

If you sign the acknowledgement I'll activate the voucher and confirm the sandbox is re-enabled for your engineers.

Best,
Marissa
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
